response: Ward H/W (Bandra West, Khar West, Santacruz West) billed INR 4245242 of its INR 4300000 budget, or 98.7 percent, across 62 repair jobs. Of these, 25.8 percent were reopened within 30 days and 45.2 percent met the repair deadline. The city saw 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, and the ward's low lying index is 0.55, which may explain some repeat damage. INR 2237982 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing, and this spending needs review. One job was priced above the 30 percent rate card tolerance and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Western Coast Asphalt Co (synthetic). A ward officer can ask whether work order WO25-02266 was on a DLP road and, if so, why the city paid for it.
